messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nHandlers are spending hours each day on phone calls, which prevents them from processing claims or managing reserves. This delays claim resolution and reduces efficiency in core tasks.\n\n## Who is affected\n- The claims handlers at Duncastle Auto, who are described as spending hours on the phone daily instead of performing their core duties [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue was mentioned 1 time in total [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- This mention came through the sales route [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- The account has an Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of 80000.0 GBP [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- A customer stated, “Every single day. We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.” [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- There is 1 account [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- There is 1 route [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n\n## Why now\n- The problem was reported on 2026-10-14 [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- The account, Duncastle Auto, is due for renewal on 2027-08-19 [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].\n- The total ARR from all accounts is 80000.0 GBP [i:10dfa29ece8d2cc7].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "10dfa29ece8d2cc7",
   "quote": "Every single day. We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.",
   "account": "Duncastle Auto",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 80000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Duncastle Auto",
    "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the quoted customer statement against the cited insight and it matches verbatim ('Every single day. We've got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.'), so the quotation is a genuine quote, not a paraphrase. The numbers all align with the fact sheet: 1 account, 1 mention, 1 route (sales), ARR of 80,000 GBP, 0 renewals in the last 90 days, report date 2026-10-14, and Duncastle Auto's renewal date of 2027-08-19. The problem framing ('delays claim resolution and reduces efficiency in core tasks') is a reasonable inference from the quote, not an overstatement, and scope is limited to the single cited account. No contrary evidence or uncited claims were found.", "verdict": "pass"}
